prompt: A young adult East Asian woman sits on a white bed beside a large window, with fair warm-toned skin, a slender build, shoulder-length slightly tousled dark brown-black hair, wispy bangs, minimal natural makeup, and soft nude-pink lips slightly parted. She sits sideways and twists her upper body toward the camera, with one arm bent overhead and her forearm resting horizontally across her forehead, while the other hand supports her from behind; her bent legs enter the foreground as she looks directly into the lens with a calm, slightly languid expression. She wears a loose, thin, slightly sheer off-white sleeveless tank top with a low scoop neckline and very deep armholes, paired with cream elastic-waist drawstring shorts; the soft fabric is naturally wrinkled with a subtle cotton-linen texture. The setting is a bright minimalist bedroom with a large back window covered by translucent white sheer curtains and soft, rumpled white bedding. Use a vertical 9:16 three-quarter seated portrait composition, with the subject centered slightly to the right and filling most of the frame; place the camera near eye level with the natural perspective of an approximately 50 mm portrait lens, letting the raised arm create a horizontal line across the forehead and the foreground legs form a gentle leading curve. Warm morning-like white sunlight pours through the curtains from behind and slightly camera-left, creating strong yet diffused backlight, mildly overexposed window highlights, golden rim light around the hair, shoulders, arms, and body, and soft fill on the face; include pale pink, light green, and golden circular lens flares across the upper torso and waist. Use an ivory white, creamy beige, pale peach skin, and warm gray palette with low saturation, low contrast, and an airy high-key exposure. Preserve a natural photographic texture with the eyes and face in sharpest focus, mild background blur, realistic fine skin detail, subtle soft focus, atmospheric haze, and highlight bloom, with no obvious grain, creating a quiet, warm, languid morning-light mood.
